responsibility: Implements the small legacy high-level GIMPLE builder helpers declared in gimple-builder.h. This file’s responsibility is to synthesize simple assignment and cast statements while hiding temporary-result creation: it infers the RHS expression type, creates SSA-name temporaries when no LHS is supplied, converts integer immediates into tree constants, and provides overloaded build_assign/build_type_cast entry points that accept trees or previously-built gimple assignments as operands and return new gassign statements.
same_name_distinction: Implements the legacy builder helper definitions declared in gcc/gimple-builder.h, providing the overloaded build_assign/build_type_cast routines that create SSA temporaries, infer result types, and construct gassigns rather than just declaring those entry points.
